title: kbid.py add writes the repository's MIT licence for a gitlab-org/gitlab doc/ page, whose LICENSE puts doc/ under CC BY-SA 4.0
goal: provider.read_licence for a gitlab.com raw or blob url under gitlab-org/gitlab doc/ gives CC BY-SA 4.0 (the repository LICENSE puts all content under doc/ under CC BY-SA 4.0) or reads nothing and leaves the pair to the flags, instead of the repository-wide MIT the GitLab API reports (seen in ST-52lihy7z: kbid.py add of signed_commits/_index.md at 9f1632e2 wrote MIT; 5 earlier doc/ rows of kb/public/_sources.csv carry the same MIT value)

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import provider; r = provider.read_licence('https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/9f1632e2d74cf3c87fce2513c999c6cf84a97ab4/doc/user/project/repository/signed_commits/_index.md'); sys.exit(1 if r['licence'].startswith('MIT') else 0)
